y-m-61-10.s.s3.prompt: Tanga wasarudza limit value L, wobva wawana ma integers a ne b anopa limit value iyoyo. Isa (a, b, L) 3 dzakasiyana, ne L dzakasiyana, kuti limit ye (x²+ax+b)/(x−1) painoswedera x ku 1 ive L (integer ne 1≤L≤5).
y-m-61-10.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora hukama pakati pe a ne b hunoita kuti numerator ive 0 pa x=1.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.hint.1: Isa hukama uhwo mu numerator, bvisa (x−1) uye uichinje, wobva watarisa kuti limit value inonyorwa sei nema a.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.ok.c1: a, b, L i ma integers uye L i pakati pe 1 ne 5 zvichisanganisirwa.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c1: a, b, L zvinofanira kuva ma integers, uye L inofanira kuva pakati pe 1 ne 5 zvichisanganisirwa.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.ok.c2: Numerator i 0 pa x=1, saka i chimiro chinogona kuchinjwa.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c2: Numerator haisi 0 pa x=1. Numerator inofanira kuva 0 kuti mutengo wakagadzikana ubude.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.ok.c3: Limit value mushure mekuchinja, a+2, inoenzana ne L.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Limit value haisi L. Nyora numerator seproduct ye (x−1) nelinear expression imwe, chinja, uye uwane limit value.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.explain: Kana 1+a+b=0, saka b=−1−a uye x²+ax−1−a=(x−1)(x+1+a). Kuchinja kunopa x+1+a, uye limit painoswedera x ku 1 i a+2. Saka L=a+2 ne b=−1−a, uye (a, b) imwe inosarudzwa pa L imwe neimwe.
